title: Payroll Administrator
description:
An independent accountancy firm in Harrogate is looking to recruit a Payroll Administrator to join its team.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with some payroll experience who is looking to develop their payroll experience. Applicants from both industry and practice backgrounds will be considered, with full training and ongoing support provided.

Responsibilities will include:
- Processing weekly, fortnightly and monthly payrolls for a portfolio of clients.
- Calculating statutory payments, including SSP, SMP and SPP.
- Processing starters, leavers and payroll amendments.
- Preparing and submitting RTI returns to HMRC.
- Assisting with pension submissions and auto-enrolment.
- Responding to client payroll queries.

The successful candidate will have:
- Payroll experience, gained in either industry or practice.
- Good attention to detail and organisational skills.
- A willingness to learn and develop their payroll knowledge.
- A friendly, approachable manner and good communication skills.

title: Technical & Quality Support Administrator
description:
Technical & Quality Support Administrator

Harrogate £28,000 - £30,000 Monday to Friday (flexible on hours)

Benefits: 25 days holiday + bank holidays, Christmas shutdown, paid sick leave, company pension, free on-site parking, training and career development opportunities

Unity Resourcing is recruiting a Technical & Quality Support Administrator for a successful and growing food manufacturing business based in Harrogate.

This is an excellent opportunity for a Food Science graduate looking to start their career, or an individual with experience in Quality Assurance, Quality Control, Technical Administration or Food Safety who is looking to further develop their skills within a supportive and fast-paced manufacturing environment.

Technical & Quality Support Administrator Duties:
- Completing customer specifications and technical documentation
- Investigating customer complaints and supporting corrective actions
- Carrying out GMP inspections and internal audits
- Supporting HACCP and food safety systems
- Maintaining quality records, procedures and documentation
- Assisting with external audits and certification requirements
- Managing supplier approvals and raw material specifications
- Supporting environmental monitoring, calibration and shelf-life testing
- Delivering training and assisting with continuous improvement activities

About You
- Degree in Food Science or a related discipline, or previous food manufacturing quality experience
- Understanding of GMP and food safety principles
- Strong attention to detail and organisational skills
- Excellent communication skills
- Confident using IT systems and technical documentation
- HACCP and audit experience would be advantageous but is not essential

To apply or discuss the opportunity further, please contact Beth Davies at Unity Resourcing or submit your CV today.
